F2 LOW: plain() (src/settings/inspect.ts:41-48) keeps bidi/zero-width characters, letting remote MCP error text spoof `swarmforge status` output. Setup: disposable detached clone at /tmp/rev38/t, git rev-parse HEAD = d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895; /workspace/repo untouched at baseline. Official Bun 1.4.2 unpacked at /tmp/rev38/bun (snapshot 1.3.14 cannot read lockfileVersion 2; lockfile never rewritten). Reviewer experiments live only under /tmp/rev38 (clone, probe/p1-p3.ts, cfg/s.toml with fake credential-shaped values) and are disclosed in the artifacts.

F1 MEDIUM (reproduced, high confidence) src/security.ts:17-22, surfaced at src/settings/inspect.ts:117,127,132 and printed by src/cli.ts:198,265,278. The shape fallbacks require userinfo with a colon and one of exactly token|key|api_key|password; the loader only learns credential values from the three SECRET_KEYS (src/settings/load.ts:459-473) and collectSecrets (src/settings/load.ts:442-453, key must match /token|key|secret|password|credential/i), so a credential in git.ssh.push_url (schema-legal, src/config.ts:62,131) or client.url is never known. Probe p2.ts: colon userinfo redacted, username-only userinfo unchanged, ?token= redacted, ?access_token=/?X-Api-Key=/?sig= unchanged. Real CLI: config show printed the client URL with its token-as-username userinfo and access_token value (secrets []); config validate printed SWARMFORGE_GIT_PUSH_URL verbatim. Guards: tests/api.test.ts:148-153 and tests/serve.test.ts:728,792-803 only cover the colon form and token=/api_key=; src/serve-command.ts:50 already treats SWARMFORGE_GIT_PUSH_URL as a secret, showing the inspection path is the inconsistent one. Fix: extract URL userinfo/query credentials into collector.secrets during resolution and broaden both fallbacks.

F2 LOW (reproduced) src/settings/inspect.ts:41-48. plain() strips only C0/C1; U+202E/U+202C/U+200B survive, while src/security.ts:63-70 (isInvisible) already strips them for untrusted model output. Remote tool-error text (src/cli/client.ts:45) is printed through scrub -> redactedText -> plain (src/cli.ts:121-132,184-186). Fix: share the isInvisible predicate. Impact is terminal spoofing only, so LOW.

F3 LOW (code-evidenced only) src/cli.ts:194,205 discards the ResolvedSettings carrying the WeakMap context; commandRedactor (src/serve-command.ts:45-52) and redactorFor (src/security.ts:43-51) rebuild a weaker set, so serve logs, the event log (src/runtime.ts:172-212) and SSE payloads would miss superseded-layer or non-credential-named credentials. No trigger found: traced startup error paths (src/providers/freestyle.ts:186-267, src/git-handoff.ts) raise fixed messages echoing neither URL nor token.

Cleared by inspection: isServer('SWARMFORGE_HOST' in value) confusion is unreachable (server always resolves the defaulted key, client value is exactly {url, token?}, src/settings/load.ts:891); no caller clones a ResolvedSettings so the WeakMap entry is never lost; superseded credentials are retained by setValue (src/settings/load.ts:656-667) and pinned by tests/inspect.test.ts:38-78; dotted TOML keys escape collectSecrets but Bun.TOML.parse/zod issues echo no values.

Limits: whole suite and packaging compile intentionally skipped (other scopes). No network, real provider or real credential used; all example values are placeholders.
